plugins.name: compass-rose
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin for project management using GitHub Projects. Provides skills, commands, and agents for managing tasks, bugs, and feature ideas.

plugins.name: notify-hook
plugins.description: Desktop/mobile notifications when Claude needs user attention. Supports ntfy.sh, Discord, and Slack.

plugins.name: lore-development
plugins.description: Builds and organizes project context through intent, research, brainstorming, optional planning, implementation, and retrospectives. Historical work artifacts are nonbinding context; current user direction takes precedence.

plugins.name: mind-reader
plugins.description: Active feedback based on session patterns and sentiment analysis. Provides gentle nudges when sessions exceed typical duration or detect frustration.

plugins.name: field-guide
plugins.description: Selectively distills useful project understanding into a searchable .lore/reference/ wiki. Historical artifacts are leads, not authority; current behavior is checked against code/tests, and adding no page is valid.
